title: Heegner points and derivatives of L-series

definitions.statement: CM point y_K on modular curve X_0(N) associated to imaginary quadratic field K with discriminant D coprime to N.
Quadratic form h_hat: E(Q) -> R measuring arithmetic complexity of rational points.
L-function L(f, chi_K, s) twisted by quadratic character of K.

theorems.label: Gross-Zagier Formula
theorems.statement: L'(E, 1) * L(E^(D), 1) = (u^2 / (8 pi^2 sqrt(|D|))) * (f, f) * h_hat(P_K) where P_K is the Trace of the Heegner point.

theorems.label: Rank 1 BSD Partial Resolution
theorems.statement: If L(E, 1) = 0 and L'(E, 1) != 0, there exists a rational point P in E(Q) of infinite order, so rank E(Q) >= 1.

conjectures.label: Higher Rank BSD Analogue
conjectures.statement: Generalization of Gross-Zagier formula to L^((r))(E, 1) for r >= 2 using higher algebraic cycles.

open_gaps: Heegner points only produce points of rank 1 in E(K); cannot construct rank 2 or higher subspaces directly.
computational_handles: Numerical evaluation of canonical height h_hat(P) via Tate's series.
CM point construction on X_0(N) via Weber modular functions.
L'(E, 1) high-precision computation via rapid exponential sum.

citations.ref: Gross, B.H., Zagier, D.B. (1986). Heegner points and derivatives of L-series, Invent. Math., 84, 225-320.
